newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Indian for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Indian for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia said it had beheaded an Indian man on Monday for smuggling heroin into the country.
The interior ministry said in a statement carried by the Saudi Press Agency that the man was executed in the capital Riyadh.
The beheading raised to 26 the number of people put to death in the conservative Islamic kingdom this year. On Sunday, it beheaded two Filipinos convicted of robbery.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
